💧 Here's how we check whether water companies are polluting our rivers: we ask the water companies to check themselves.

It's called operator self-monitoring, it's been running since 2009 — and here's the killer detail. If the flow is too low to take a sample at all, a "no-flow event", it is NOT recorded as a fail.

A blank page marked as full marks.

Seven former Southern Water employees appeared in court on Friday over allegations connected to that regime. I want to be crystal clear: those charges are unproven, all deny wrongdoing, and it is for a jury to decide — not me, and not Facebook.

But the design of the system needs no verdict. It was badly built from day one. And meanwhile Ofwat has just provisionally waved through £3.4bn more, with five companies allowed to put it on your bill from 2027.

👉 End self-monitoring. Independent testing, published in full, paid for by the companies.
